segments.name: Digital financial solutions
products: digital lending and relationship pricing solutions
segments.description: Provides cloud-based digital banking, lending, risk and fraud, and open platform solutions to financial institutions, FinTechs and alternative finance companies.
segments.evidence: Revenue-generating activities directly relate to the sale, implementation and support of our solutions within a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Financial institutions and FinTechs pay subscription fees for hosted solutions plus usage-based transactional fees, and professional and implementation services, recognized over customer agreement terms.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive the majority of our revenues from subscription fees for the use of our hosted solutions, transactional revenue from bill-pay solutions and remote deposit products, revenues for professional services and implementation services related to our solutions and certain third-party related pass-through fees.
